title: Borel–Moore sections and their proper pushforward
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]
and the coefficient
conventions [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], $A=A_{E,n}$, $s=\Spec k$. Let $T$ be a
separated finite-type
$k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] whose structure morphism $a_T:T\to s$ is
exceptionally admissible, with
dualizing complex $\omega_T=\omega_{T,A}=Ra_T^!A_s$ of
[def-trf-dualizing-complex]. A *Borel–Moore section* on $T$ is a
morphism

$$
\alpha:A_T\longrightarrow\omega_T
$$

in $D(T,A)$, the derived category of sheaves of $A$-modules on the
small pro-etale site of $T$, where $A_T$ is the constant coefficient
sheaf [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]; they form the $A$-module
$\Hom_{D(T,A)}(A_T,\omega_T)$.

Let $h:T\to T'$ be a proper
morphism of such $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with $h$, $a_T$ and $a_{T'}$
exceptionally admissible [def-trf-admissibility] (so $a_T=a_{T'}\circ h$). For a
Borel–Moore section $\alpha$ on $T$, its *pushforward*
$h_*\alpha:A_{T'}\to\omega_{T'}$ is the composite

$$
A_{T'}\xrightarrow{\ \eta_h\ }Rh_*A_T
\xrightarrow{\ Rh_*\alpha\ }Rh_*\omega_T
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rh_!Rh^!\omega_{T'}
\xrightarrow{\ \varepsilon_h\ }\omega_{T'},
$$

where:

- $\eta_h$ is the unit of the adjunction $Lh^*\dashv Rh_*$ of the
  derived direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image], with adjunction
  as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], at
  $A_{T'}$, using the canonical identification $Lh^*A_{T'}\cong A_T$
  of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom];
- the isomorphism is the identification $Rh_*\cong Rh_!$ for the
  proper $h$ of [prop-functor-package], clause (3), for the compact-support
  direct image of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed],
  followed by $Rh_!$ applied to the inverse of the canonical
  isomorphism $Rh^!\omega_{T'}\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_T$ of
  [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition] (applied with $d=h$,
  $X=T'$, $F=T$);
- $\varepsilon_h$ is the counit of the adjunction
  $Rh_!\dashv Rh^!$ of [def-trf-admissibility] at $\omega_{T'}$.

Since each arrow other than $Rh_*\alpha$ is independent of
$\alpha$ and $Rh_*$ is an additive $A$-linear functor, the map
$\alpha\mapsto h_*\alpha$ is $A$-linear.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NI-3787b7b0c (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: PASS, with no fixes and no nodes dropped. I read the item against main-20261015 sk-d-integral/def-trf-borel-moore-pushforward.md:8-54; its statement body is identical to the master copy at order 2282. The delivery keeps the source's hypotheses, objects and four-arrow composite. It only adds citations and replaces the source's 'Lh^*A_{T'}=A_T' with the canonical iso from def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom (c^h_A). I checked each arrow against the cited statements. (1) eta_h is the unit of the Lu^*-|Ru_* adjunction in def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, for the derived direct image of def-weil-derived-direct-image; that node needs ell invertible, which holds since ell != p. (2) The proper comparison Rh_* = Rh_! is prop-functor-package clause (3), on D^b_ctf at finite stages. omega_T is in D^b_ctf because A_s is free of rank one and admissibility preserves D^b_ctf. The second reading was right to move this citation off def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed, whose statement does not assert the comparison. Next comes Rh_! of the inverse of the iso in thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition, applied with d=h, X=T', F=T; its hypotheses hold and the arrows compose in the right direction. (3) eps_h is the counit of the constructible adjunction Rh_!-|Rh^! on D^b_ctf in def-trf-admissibility, not the ambient adjoint, which fails in general. The A-linearity sentence is elementary (bilinear composition and A-linear Rh_*) and comes from the source. The coefficient category is A_{E,n} on the pro-etale site throughout, as in the master source. Edge cases: T empty gives zero; h=id on Spec k gives the identity on End(A_s)=A; n=1 is allowed. There are no new nodes. All 11 cited ids exist and none is merged, and the dependencies from the item form no cycle. I found no duplicate: sk-d-proper-pushforward and def-trf-coefficient-pushforward push forward correspondences, and sk-d-integral is correctly recorded in same_as. The item is a definition with no proof steps, so the route rule does not apply, and no tool_uses are needed. The Mathlib searches cover all three kinds, and leaving the generic GeometricOperations declarations unattached is justified. No SGA source is used. The unit's realized field is still empty and needs def-trf-integration as well; that is for the maintainer, not a fault of this delivery.
